content.short: Native is Web3's Liquidity Layer unifying bridging, assets, and pricing into one comprehensive solution for DeFi protocols and traders on Mantle.
content.description: Native is building comprehensive liquidity infrastructure for Web3, combining swap aggregation, lending markets, and cross-chain bridging into a unified platform powered by a network of professional market makers for optimal execution without idle capital. On Mantle, Native offers both retail swapping and institutional-grade lending services, positioning itself as a foundational liquidity primitive that other DeFi protocols can build on top of for reliable capital access.
